I forgot my gloves. My hands are frozen.

phrases.ru: Я мёрзну больше других. / Я мерзляк. (брит.)
phrases.ex: Are you cold? It's warm! / I feel the cold.
I don't mind the cold. I'm from Siberia!
I can't stand the heat. I prefer winter.
It's minus ten today. Wrap up warm!
Bye, Mum! / Don't forget your coat!
Do I need a jacket? / Yes, it's cold.

phrases.en: Is it cold enough for a coat?
phrases.ex: Is it cold enough for a coat? / Just a jacket.

phrases.en: Close the window, there's a draught.
phrases.ex: Close the window, there's a draught.

phrases.en: Can you turn the heating up?
phrases.ex: Can you turn the heating up? It's cold in here.

phrases.en: It's lovely and warm in here.
phrases.ex: Come in! / Oh, it's lovely and warm in here.

phrases.ru: От этой погоды меня клонит в сон.
phrases.ex: This weather makes me sleepy. I want to stay in bed.
Rain again! I hate this weather.
It's dark at five. The days are getting shorter.

phrases.en: It gets dark at four in winter.
phrases.ex: It gets dark at four in winter in London.
Spring is finally here! Look at the flowers.
It's autumn. The leaves are changing colour.
What's your favourite season? / Autumn.
I love autumn. The colours are beautiful.

phrases.en: What's the weather like in Moscow in winter?
phrases.ex: What's the weather like in Moscow in winter? / Cold and snowy.
Is Moscow cold in winter? / It can get really cold.
We have long, cold winters and short summers.
What about the summer? / Summers are short but hot.
Sun, then rain, then sun again. / It's typical British weather.

phrases.en: You can have four seasons in one day here.
phrases.ru: Здесь бывает четыре времени года за один день.
phrases.ex: You can have four seasons in one day here. Always take a jacket.
It's unusually warm for October. Twenty degrees!

phrases.en: We didn't have much of a summer this year.
phrases.ru: В этом году лета, считай, не было.
phrases.ex: We didn't have much of a summer this year. It rained all August.
The winters are getting milder. We hardly have snow now.

phrases.en: It's much hotter than it used to be.
phrases.ex: It's much hotter than it used to be in summer.

phrases.en: We haven't had rain for weeks.
phrases.ru: Дождя не было уже несколько недель.
phrases.ex: We haven't had rain for weeks. The grass is brown.
The garden needs rain. Everything is dry.

phrases.en: There's been flooding in the north.
phrases.ex: Did you see the news? There's been flooding in the north.

phrases.en: The match was cancelled because of the weather.
phrases.ex: The match was cancelled because of the weather. Too much snow.

phrases.en: If it's nice tomorrow, let's have a picnic.
phrases.ru: Если завтра будет хорошая погода, давай устроим пикник.
phrases.ex: If it's nice tomorrow, let's have a picnic in the park.

phrases.en: If it rains, we'll stay in.
phrases.ex: What's the plan? / If it rains, we'll stay in.

phrases.en: It's not a day for going out.
phrases.ru: Не тот день, чтобы выходить из дома.
phrases.ex: It's not a day for going out. Let's watch a film.

phrases.ru: Будем надеяться на хорошую погоду. (скрестим пальцы)
phrases.ex: The wedding is on Saturday. Fingers crossed for good weather!

phrases.en: We were lucky with the weather.
phrases.ex: How was your holiday? / Great. We were lucky with the weather.

phrases.en: The weather was awful on holiday.
phrases.ex: The weather was awful on holiday. We stayed in the hotel.

phrases.ru: Правда, в последнее время тепло? (вопрос для small talk)
phrases.ex: Hasn't it been warm lately? / Yes, lovely.
Cold enough for you? / Ha! Yes, I'm freezing.

phrases.en: Bit grim out there, isn't it?
phrases.ru: Мерзко на улице, да? (брит., small talk)
phrases.ex: Bit grim out there, isn't it? / Awful. Wet and cold.
It's so cold. / At least it's not raining.
Grey again. / It could be worse. It could be snowing.

phrases.en: The weather's been all over the place.
phrases.ex: Hot on Monday, snow on Wednesday. The weather's been all over the place.
What a horrible day. / Hopefully it'll be better tomorrow.
